context.conditions_zh: 仅限固定 Recommendation 明确规定的媒体 API 行为：只读参数 RTCRtcpParameters.reducedSize 为 false 时， 表示配置了 RFC 3550 复合 RTCP；为 true 时表示 RFC 5506 精简 RTCP，而非所有会话都采用复合 RTCP。 RTCRtpTransceiver 停止发送与接收算法的第 3 步要求停止媒体发送，并按 RFC 3550 为此前发送的各 RTP 流发送 RTCP BYE。 不扩展为数据通道使用 RTP，不把整个 IETF RTCWEB 协议族视为该 W3C API 规范，也不推定明文媒体传输、浏览器符合性或实际互通。
context.conditions_en: Limited to media API behavior explicitly specified by the fixed Recommendation. The read-only RTCRtcpParameters.reducedSize parameter indicates RFC 3550 compound RTCP when false and RFC 5506 reduced-size RTCP when true; compound RTCP is not asserted for every session. Step 3 of the RTCRtpTransceiver stop-sending-and-receiving algorithm stops media sending and sends an RFC 3550 RTCP BYE for each RTP stream that the sender was sending. This does not extend RTP use to data channels, equate the IETF RTCWEB protocol suite with this W3C API specification, or imply plaintext media transport, browser conformance, or actual interoperability.

context.conditions_en: Limited to semantics and focus information for accessible interaction, not a complete interaction implementation. Authors must manage focus for the listed composite-container roles. With aria-activedescendant, assistive technology receives active-descendant focus information while DOM focus can remain on the container or controlling input. aria-keyshortcuts exposes shortcuts without automatically changing user-agent keyboard behavior; authors must handle scripted keyboard events. This does not establish usability evaluation or page conformance.

context.conditions_zh: 限定为 YAML 表示图、序列化树与字符流之间的数据表示和转换。映射键顺序与锚点名称是序列化细节，注释和样式是呈现细节，不构成原生数据构造所依据的信息；这不表示样式对标签解析毫无影响：plain scalar 在标签解析中需与带引号的标量区分，构造阶段则依据表示图。此边不承诺往返保留这些细节。完整加载还依赖标签解析、标签内容有效性和可用原生类型，不能据格式能力推断任意处理器或跨应用往返成功。本次未验证 IA 实际 YAML 处理、实现符合性或应用互通。
context.conditions_en: Limited to data representation and conversion among YAML representation graphs, serialization trees and character streams. Mapping key order and anchor names are serialization details; comments and styles are presentation details, not information used to construct native data. This does not mean styles never affect tag resolution: plain scalars are distinguished from quoted scalars for that purpose; construction uses the representation graph. This edge does not promise their round-trip preservation. Complete loading also depends on tag resolution, tag/content validity and available native types; the format capability does not prove arbitrary processor or cross-application round trips. IA YAML processing, implementation conformance and application interoperability were not tested.
